scope.representativePointPolicy: one regional representative point per subregion; no per-course climate records
scope.observationPolicy: No daily real-time observation ingestion, station discovery, station boundary work, or station-based operational dependency

prohibitedClaims: daily rain probability without calibrated hindcast mapping
horizons.dailyOutput: One estimated record per local date D19-D46, generated from historical daily analogues/stochastic sequences conditioned by weekly ECMWF ensemble signals.

prohibitedClaims: daily precision derived from monthly anomaly
horizons.dailyOutput: One estimated record per local date D47-D90, generated from historical daily analogues/stochastic sequences conditioned by C3S monthly multi-model signals; lower confidence when monthly signals provide weak daily discrimination.

sources.role: regional historical climate distribution and seasonal prior
sources.refreshPolicy: static baseline; refresh only when reference period or dataset version is intentionally revised

sources.role: primary forecast anomaly signal for D19-D46
sources.refreshPolicy: use latest available operational cycle; no daily station observations

sources.role: primary multi-model climate anomaly signal for D47-D90
variables: monthly precipitation anomaly and tercile probabilities
monthly 2m temperature anomaly and tercile probabilities
sources.refreshPolicy: monthly cycle; retain model/system/version and matching hindcast provenance

sources.role: optional secondary daily-shaped model signal for research and comparison only
sources.refreshPolicy: not an operational dependency until per-region hindcast verification passes
restrictions: daily-shaped output is not proof of daily forecast skill
no rain probability inferred from rainfall amount
do not use as sole D47-D90 forecast

decisionMethod.unit: one daily record per date, plus rolling seven-day trip-window analysis
decisionMethod.tripPattern: five days four nights with three golf rounds
decisionMethod.coreOutput: daily estimated weather series for D19-D90 plus advisory seven-day departure-window comparison; user makes final date choice
metrics: daily estimated precipitation amount and uncertainty range
daily precipitation risk category (numeric probability only after calibration)
daily estimated Tmin/Tmax/mean temperature and uncertainty
daily wind/cloud/sunshine tendencies where source support exists
seven-day aggregation showing three-round planning suitability and risks

calibration.method: hindcast/reforecast-based quantile mapping and probability calibration, stratified by region, season and lead-time band
requiredMetrics: CRPS where ensemble distributions support it

decisionMethod.probabilityPolicy: Daily estimated weather values must be generated for every date D19-D90. Numeric daily rain/playability probabilities are withheld until date-level hindcast calibration passes; until then provide estimated amount/ranges, categorical risk, and explicit confidence. The app's date ranking is advisory only; the user reviews daily records and chooses.
decisionMethod.missingDataPolicy: Missing forecast or historical inputs remain unavailable; do not substitute zero or silently fall back to an unrelated model.

dailyGeneration.method: conditional historical analogue sequences / calibrated stochastic weather generator
dailyGeneration.sequencePreservation: sample coherent multi-day sequences and preserve precipitation-temperature-wind dependence
dailyGeneration.conditioning: date-specific day-of-year prior plus overlapping weekly/monthly forecast anomaly and validated daily model signals
dailyGeneration.uncertainty: retain daily median, prediction interval, analogue/member count and confidence by variable
dailyGeneration.prohibited: copy weekly/monthly mean to each day; independently randomize each date; infer rain probability from rainfall amount; present generated values as deterministic forecast

operations.d19D46Refresh: when new ECMWF extended-range cycle is available
operations.d47D90Refresh: when new C3S seasonal cycle is available

activationGates: 80 regional representative points remain structurally valid
1991-2020 regional historical climate distributions acquired and QA checked
ECMWF extended-range forecast and matching hindcasts are ingested with weekly valid periods
C3S multi-system forecast and matching hindcasts are ingested with model/version provenance
hindcast calibration and skill are reported separately for all four lead bands
seven-day / three-round ranking passes backtest without modifying D01-D16 or UI

dailyOutputContract.purpose: Produce a date-by-date estimated weather dataset for every calendar day D19-D90. The daily estimates are decision-support inputs; app analysis is advisory and the user independently chooses the departure date.
dailyOutputContract.granularity: one record per local calendar date per regional representative point
dailyOutputContract.dataNature: D19-D90 daily values are estimated daily distributions or representative daily scenarios, not deterministic forecasts. Preserve quantiles/ranges and uncertainty; never imply exact local weather.
generationMethod: Use ERA5-Land 1991-2020 day-of-year daily distributions as the regional historical prior.
Use ECMWF D19-D46 weekly ensemble anomalies and probabilities as conditioning signals for each overlapping local date.
Use C3S D47-D90 monthly multi-system anomalies and tercile probabilities as conditioning signals for each local date.
Use validated daily-shaped seasonal model outputs from independent model systems as additional daily structure only where hindcast skill is demonstrated.
Generate date-specific estimates by conditional analog selection or a calibrated stochastic weather generator trained on historical daily sequences; condition on forecast anomalies and season.

Preserve realistic multi-day weather persistence and cross-variable dependence by sampling complete historical weather sequences or calibrated ensemble trajectories, not independent random values for each date.
Summarize daily ensemble/analog distributions with median and prediction intervals; retain the full member/analog trace for audit.
dailyOutputContract.dailyVsPeriodSignalRule: Weekly/monthly forecast anomalies adjust the distribution of each date in their valid period; they do not get copied as identical values to every day. Daily variability is supplied by historical analog sequences and validated daily model structure. If daily structure is not supported, expose broad uncertainty and lower confidence rather than fabricate detail.

userDecisionPolicy.appRole: Display daily estimated weather and a separate advisory summary/ranking to help compare candidate departure windows.
userDecisionPolicy.userRole: User reviews the individual daily estimates and chooses the departure date; app must never imply the recommendation is a booking instruction or automatic decision.

dailyOutputContract.numericProbabilityPolicy: Daily numeric precipitation/playability probabilities are permitted only after date-level hindcast calibration passes for that region, season and lead band. Before then show estimated rainfall amount/range and categorical risk with explicit uncertainty; do not invent a rain probability.

validation.sequenceValidation: Validate seven-day sequence properties and at-least-three-playable-days estimates against hindcast windows; do not assume daily independence.
validation.sourceDiversityRule: Count genuinely independent forecast systems only; do not treat multiple products derived from the same model family as independent votes.
